messages:
Sunny Patel: Hi all  Sunny here, first day on Data Platform (BST). Super excited to jump in! Quick q: I haven't gotten the MDM invite or Slack access yet. Who should I nudge?
Marta Li: Welcome Sunny :tada: I'm Marta from DevEx. I can check SSO mapping. Can you confirm the email used to sign up?
Sunny Patel: Thanks Marta  sunny.patel@gmail.com. Also laptop status says "label printed" and tracking link is empty. Any ETA?
IT Desk: Hi Sunny  shipping shows ETA tomorrow morning. For immediate work we can provision a temporary bastion account. DM the email you want associated with the temp account and we'll send creds.
DevEx Bot: New-hire checklist created for Sunny Patel  tasks: enroll SSO, MDM, security training, join #data-platform and #new-hires.
Jess (Data Platform): Hey Sunny :wave: I'm Jess, your team buddy this week. I'll add you to the sprint board and book a 30-min orientation tomorrow. Fun fact: I have a tiny bonsai that refuses to cooperate.
Sunny Patel: Love bonsai. Fun fact about me: I build playlist mixtapes for friends and once made a 6-hour road-trip mixtape :notes: Also accepted Slack invite now  can see #new-hires but not #data-platform yet.
Marta Li: I've invited you to #data-platform and sent the org/GitHub invite. If you still can't access repos after accepting, clear cookies or try incognito and ping here.
IT Desk: Temporary bastion account created: sunny_temp. Credentials DM'd. We'll update you when the laptop ships.
Sunny Patel: Got the temp creds and GitHub invite, thanks everyone! Looking forward to the orientation tomorrow.
